name: Gasthof-Pension Gradlwirt
beschreibung:
Centrally located in picturesque Niederndorf, the traditional Gradlwirt welcomes guests with comfortable rooms and hearty Tyrolean dishes. Attentive service ensures a pleasant stay.

The Zahmer Kaiser mountains, riverside cycling along the Inn, and Kufstein Fortress are only minutes away.
kurzbeschreibung: Gasthof-Pension Gradlwirt in Niederndorf provides warm hospitality and relaxation in Kufsteinerland.
